mapper.insert: insert into product (name, description, sku, category_id, status, price, is_del, create_time, update_time) values (#{name}, #{description}, #{sku}, #{categoryId}, #{status}, #{price}, #{isDel}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update product set is_del = 1, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_del = 0
mapper.select: select p.id, p.name, p.description, p.sku, p.category_id, pt.name as category_name, pt.description as category_description, pt.type_code as category_code, p.status, p.price, p.is_del, p.create_time, p.update_time from product p left join product_type pt on p.category_id = pt.id where p.id = #{id} and p.is_del = 0
mapper.update: update product set name = #{name}, description = #{description}, sku = #{sku}, category_id = #{categoryId}, status = #{status}, price = #{price}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_del = 0
mapper.select: select count(1) from product where category_id = #{categoryId} and is_del = 0

select p.id, p.name, p.description, p.sku, p.category_id, pt.name as category_name, pt.description as category_description, pt.type_code as category_code, p.status, p.price, p.is_del, p.create_time, p.update_time from product p left join product_type pt on p.category_id = pt.id
order by p.id desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}
